gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan reads large and open, with terminals that never pinch shut. Visitor is best at crossbars as heavy as its stems, while the body font stays light and quiet.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Visitor looks drawn with a single pen tip, its e mouths gaping and its bowls oversized. Noto Sans Elymaic follows in open, easy lines.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Chunky pixel-age charm, drawn by a marker nib that ignores direction, then Noto Sans Ethiopic arrives with sturdy, tall lowercase. Visitor earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Retro and blocky, Visitor holds a steady marker-like weight, while Noto Sans Gurmukhi sends its terminals pointing outward like tongs. Both stay tidy together.
